d: While Abby leads a team to a distant location, hoping to find answers, the continued struggles with leadership and trust in Arkadia and Polis take a violent turn.
Clarke makes a desperate plea with a former allied force in an attempt to avoid a war and ensure the survival of her people.
The Fringe team revisits the past.
The Fringe Team investigates a group of thieves who can break the laws of gravity. Meanwhile, Walter attempts to delay the damage he's caused to the fabric of the universe.
When the Fringe Team investigates an apparent suicide victim, they uncover a second set of fingerprints, leading them to a woman with uncanny characteristics that cannot die.
Olivia endures life "over there."
The team tries to extract Bell's consciousness out of Olivia.
Walternate finds a way to wreak havoc "over here."
Olivia must trust Sam Weiss in a desperate race against time.
Clarke and Roan (series star ZACH McGOWAN) must work together in hostile territory in order to deliver an invaluable asset to Abby and her team.
Clarke's arrival on the island quickly takes a turn for the worse.  Meanwhile, Bellamy tries to avoid further tragedy in Arkadia.
After a disappointing discovery, Clarke and Abby question how far they're willing to go.  Meanwhile, Jaha finds a lead to the mysterious Second Dawn.
Jasper and Bellamy go on a quest. Meanwhile, Clarke struggles to keep the peace after word of Jaha's discovery spreads.
Octavia fights in the final battle for her people's survival, but not everyone is willing to play fair.
Series star Henry Ian Cusick directs the episode in which Clarke faces the consequences of her fateful choice.
Destiny and demise collide on the season three finale!
One week after Peter Bishop saved the day and was then wiped from existence, the truce between the two worlds remains intact, and the two sides are forced to work together.
A highly intelligent serial killer "over there" forces the two Fringe teams to work together as the killer's doppelganger "over here" is brought into the fold to help.
The Fringe team investigates a mysterious case of murder and rapid decomposition, uncovering an amorphous figure claiming more victims.  Walter's distracted by hallucinations.
When Olivia discovers a dangerous force connected to Walter's past, she forces him to leave the lab for the first time in years and come face-to-face with the demons of his past.
